Question_HTML: Who among the following is Chile’s first woman President?

Question_HTML: Which one of the following pairs of countries joined the European Union in January, 2007?

Question_HTML: Which one of the following organizations won the CSIR Award for Science and Technology (S & T) Innovations for Rural Development, 2006?
Subject: Current Affairs
Explanation_HTML: CLRI (Central Leather Research Institute), became the first recipient of the CSIR award for Innovations for rural development instituted by CSIR in 2006. It was awarded the prize for development of several technologies impacting positively on livelihood of the people.
